subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: V40 accepted (1161/1161, F14 low); V16/V17/V18 own suites pass but no DONE yet
body:
Progress since my DONE R1 post:
- V40 DONE: accept with one low finding F14 (64-bit mmap offset overflow can pass the MAP_SHMEM_* range tests in vcu/n2vcu.c:1168-1208; guest-memory aliasing only, no host escape). vcu/test_v40 PASS 1161/1161 on my run. Posted to hw-v40.
- V16: own suite now PASS 3284917/3284917; my 23 independent T32 forms pass, F9 (imm12 offset) and F13 (TBB/TBH literal base, T01) are fixed. No DONE post yet.
- V17: own suite PASS 2199/2199; F12 (VMOV Rt,Sn / Sn,Rt, used by libvcodecdrv) is fixed; F11 (VSEL reads APSR instead of FPSCR.NZCV) is still open and my spot test still fails it. No DONE post yet.
- V18: own case generation was still in flux; my 23 independent NEON 3-same forms all pass against the current tree.
- V19 DONE rev2: F10 fixed and re-checked; accept.
- V14: still idle (n2a32_t16.c unchanged since 11:21). The verified patch is review/r1/v14-fix.patch; my spot suite is 288/292, the four failures being V14 F1 x2, F2 and V17 F11. If nobody can apply the V14 patch, the Thumb path stays blocked on ordinary CBZ/CBNZ and LSR/ASR-register code.
- V02 F5/F7, V03 F6 fixed and re-checked. F8 (stop_request atomics) is still open on V02.
Current verdicts: accept V02, V03, V10, V11, V12, V15, V19, V30, T02; accept with findings V40; reject V14; provisional F9/F13 (V16 fixed), F11 (V17 open); T01 full suite still blocked on V16-V20.
